protocols.name: Profiler
protocols.purpose: Separate observations, plausible explanations and role constraints before choosing a communication strategy.

protocols.name: Profiler Plus
protocols.purpose: Turn contextual understanding into a grounded message or decision package the recipient can act on.

protocols.name: Dopamine Hooks
protocols.purpose: Make relevance visible and deliver meaningful closure without fake urgency or neurochemical claims.

protocols.name: Reverse
protocols.purpose: Check a drafted message from the recipient side and challenge the sender’s assumptions.

protocols.name: Rail
protocols.purpose: Turn an unfinished request into a usable path of actions while preserving independent judgment.
